---
name: Safety data correction
about: Report a potentially inaccurate or stale health, treatment, emergency, or legal record
title: "[Safety data] "
labels: safety
---

## Affected feature

Identify the screen, record, jurisdiction, or source.

## Current behavior

Describe exactly what Harm.Less currently shows.

## Authoritative correction

Provide the authoritative source or citation that supports the correction.

## Why it matters

Explain the practical safety consequence of the discrepancy.

## Verification

Include the date checked and any relevant source version or update date. Do not include personal health information, credentials, or other sensitive data.
